const LOOK := preload("res://scripts/world/stormwood_look.gd")
const VISIBILITY := preload("res://scripts/world/foliage_camera_visibility.gd")
const FADE := preload("res://scripts/world/foliage_fight_fade.gd")
const MODEL := "res://assets/environment/stylized_nature/TwistedTree_2.gltf"
const SOURCE := "14e7ff6934a941e53d8d0009e633dfbccfc114cb"
var failures: Array[String] = []
var checks := 0
var owner: Node3D

func _init() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func check(value: bool, message: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not value:
		failures.append(message)

func _run() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless" or RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method() != "forward_plus":
		push_error("Material integration requires a native Forward+ device")
		quit(2)
		return
	if not OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has("--source-commit=" + SOURCE):
		push_error("Material fixture requires its exact source argument")
		quit(2)
		return
	owner = Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(owner)
	var camera := Camera3D.new()
	owner.add_child(camera)
	camera.position = Vector3(0, 1, 7)
	camera.look_at(Vector3.ZERO)
	camera.make_current()
	var light := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	owner.add_child(light)
	light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-35, 20, 0)
	var look := LOOK.new()
	look.config = LOOK.read_config()
	check(not bool(look.config.enabled), "committed shared-look flag remains OFF")
	# Enable only this detached fixture helper; no config or save writes.
	look.config.enabled = true
	look._build_detail_textures()
	for _frame in 120:
		await process_frame
		if look._detail_normal.get_image() != null and look._detail_colour.get_image() != null:
			break
	check(look._detail_normal.get_image() != null, "detail normal generated")
	check(look._detail_colour.get_image() != null, "detail albedo generated")
	var cfg := VISIBILITY.config()
	check(bool(cfg.near_lens_fade.enabled), "merged native near-lens treatment is enabled")
	check(not bool(cfg.line_of_sight_fade.enabled), "committed fight fade stays OFF")
	var fade := FADE.new()
	for index in 3:
		var source := ArrayMesh.new()
		source.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, BoxMesh.new().get_mesh_arrays())
		var authored := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		var image := Image.create(4, 4, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
		image.fill(Color(0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0))
		authored.normal_enabled = true
		authored.normal_texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
		authored.normal_scale = 0.7
		authored.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA_SCISSOR
		authored.alpha_scissor_threshold = 0.31
		authored.albedo_color = Color("73916c")
		source.surface_set_material(0, authored)
		var treated := VISIBILITY.near_lens_fade(source, MODEL, "stormwood")
		if index > 0:
			treated = look.adapt_mesh(treated)
		var before := treated.surface_get_material(0) as StandardMaterial3D
		check(before != null, "near/detail pipeline retains StandardMaterial before conversion")
		if before == null:
			continue
		check(before.normal_texture == authored.normal_texture and before.normal_enabled and is_equal_approx(before.normal_scale, 0.7), "authored normal binding preserved")
		check(before.distance_fade_mode == BaseMaterial3D.DISTANCE_FADE_PIXEL_DITHER, "near-lens fade survives detail")
		check(is_equal_approx(before.distance_fade_min_distance, float(cfg.near_lens_fade.invisible_below_m)) and is_equal_approx(before.distance_fade_max_distance, float(cfg.near_lens_fade.opaque_above_m)), "authored fade distances preserved")
		check(before.albedo_color == authored.albedo_color and is_equal_approx(before.alpha_scissor_threshold, 0.31), "tint and cutout preserved")
		check(before.detail_enabled == (index > 0), "detail flag follows fixture treatment")
		if index > 0:
			check(before.detail_normal == look._detail_normal and before.detail_albedo == look._detail_colour, "generated detail maps survive")
		var fade_cfg: Dictionary = cfg.line_of_sight_fade.duplicate(true)
		fade_cfg.enabled = index == 2
		var generated := FADE.STANDARD.code(before)
		check(not generated.is_empty(), "combined material features have an explicit supported conversion")
		var finished := fade.apply(treated, MODEL, "stormwood", fade_cfg)
		if index == 2:
			var converted := finished.surface_get_material(0) as ShaderMaterial
			check(converted != null, "enabled fight fade converts finished material")
			if converted != null:
				check(not generated.is_empty() and converted.shader.code == FADE.inject(generated), "complete supported normal/detail/fade shader retained")
				check(converted.get_meta("fight_fade_source") == before, "converter retains completed source textures")
				for parameter: Dictionary in converted.shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
					if str(parameter.name).begins_with("tb_fight_"):
						continue
					check(RenderingServer.material_get_param(converted.get_rid(), parameter.name) == RenderingServer.material_get_param(before.get_rid(), parameter.name), "shader parameter preserved: " + str(parameter.name))
				for uniform in ["texture_normal", "normal_scale", "texture_detail_albedo", "texture_detail_normal", "uv2_scale", "uv2_blend_sharpness", "alpha_scissor_threshold", "distance_fade_min", "distance_fade_max"]:
					check(RenderingServer.material_get_param(before.get_rid(), uniform) != null, "source feature has a bound public parameter: " + uniform)
					check(converted.get_shader_parameter(uniform) != null, "converted feature remains bound: " + uniform)
				check(generated.contains("MODEL_MATRIX") and generated.contains("texture_detail_mask") and generated.contains("NORMAL_MAP_DEPTH = normal_scale"), "world detail and authored normal scale coexist")
				var unsupported := before.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
				unsupported.emission_enabled = true
				var unsupported_mesh := treated.duplicate() as Mesh
				unsupported_mesh.surface_set_material(0, unsupported)
				var guarded := FADE.new()
				check(guarded.apply(unsupported_mesh, MODEL, "stormwood", fade_cfg).surface_get_material(0) == unsupported, "unsupported active features keep the exact original material")
				check(not guarded.has_materials(), "unsupported material registers no fade target")
				fade.target(1, Vector3(0, 0, -2))
				fade.update(camera.global_position, 0.2)
				check(float(converted.get_shader_parameter("tb_fight_strength")) > 0.0, "runtime fade reference reaches rendered material")
				fade.target(1, Vector3.INF)
				check(float(converted.get_shader_parameter("tb_fight_strength")) == 0.0, "arena release clears fade")
		else:
			check(finished == treated, "disabled fight fade is identity")
		check(finished.surface_get_arrays(0) == source.surface_get_arrays(0), "geometry preserved")
		check(not authored.detail_enabled and authored.distance_fade_mode == BaseMaterial3D.DISTANCE_FADE_DISABLED, "imported source remains untouched")
		var visual := MeshInstance3D.new()
		visual.mesh = finished
		visual.position.x = float(index - 1) * 2.0
		owner.add_child(visual)
	for _frame in 30:
		await process_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	for failure in failures:
		push_error("Material interaction: " + failure)
	print("STORMWOOD_MATERIAL_INTERACTION ", "PASS" if failures.is_empty() else "FAIL", " cases=3 checks=", checks, " failures=", failures.size())
	fade.clear()
	look.free()
	quit(0 if failures.is_empty() else 1)
